name: EZuite ERP Sync
description: Sync cadence, direction and CCT storage for the EZuite ERP Sync toolkit. The connection checklist reads the Remote Sites store and the field mapping is a key/value table, so neither is expressible here and both are configured on the WordPress screen.

settings.label: Sync interval (minutes)
settings.description: How often the full sync runs. Shorter intervals increase API load.

settings.label: Sync direction
settings.description: Read-only caches the catalog without writing to WooCommerce.

settings.label: Update WooCommerce stock
settings.description: Writes EZuite stock quantities back to WooCommerce products.

settings.label: Low stock threshold
settings.description: Quantity below which an item is reported as low stock.

settings.label: CCT slug
settings.description: JetEngine CCT slug used for inventory storage, which must be unique. Leave blank to use the toolkit default.
